candidates.exact_span: Input pollutant geometric mean concentration as micro-gram per liter (ug/l or ppb) unless other unit is specified for the parameter.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether reported measurements are aggregated as geometric means and expressed in ug/l/ppb versus another unit changes the numeric value compared against enforceable limits.

candidates.exact_span: Effluent value reported as "< detection level" (DL) but the DL is greater than MQL, input "1/2 DL" for calculation.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Treating a non-detect as half the detection limit versus a true non-detect changes the effluent concentration used for limit comparison (A) and whether the period is classified as having usable numeric data versus a documented no-data/non-detect state (C).

candidates.exact_span: Effluent value reported as "< detection level" (DL) and the DL is smaller than MQL, no data is inputted.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpreting DL<MQL as absence of input data versus a substitute numeric value changes whether a compliance comparison is performed (A) and whether the case is documented no-data, not-required, or missing-evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: If a less than MQL vakue is reported, input either the reported value or "0" for calculation.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Choosing the reported sub-MQL value versus zero alters computed effluent concentration and potential exceedance outcomes (A) and affects classification of sub-MQL results as usable numeric evidence versus a treated-as-zero/no-data state (C).

The instream waste concentration formula determines derived compliance concentrations; different inputs or formula application change whether reported measurements exceed applicable water-quality-based limits.

candidates.exact_span: F = Fraction of stream allow ed for mixing (see "Procedures for Implementing NPDES Permits in New Mexico")
candidates.computation_change_reason: The mixing fraction F is externally referenced and not fixed in this segment; a different F value changes Cd and therefore which numeric limit threshold applies or is exceeded.

candidates.exact_span: Qa = Critical low flow of stream at discharge point expressed as the 4Q3 or harmonic mean flow for human health criteria
candidates.computation_change_reason: Selecting 4Q3 versus harmonic mean for Qa changes dilution in the Cd calculation and can change the effective applicable limit or exceedance determination.
This partitioning ratio converts total-metal criteria to dissolved form; interpretation of Kp, TSS, or scaling affects the dissolved numeric limit used for compliance comparison.

candidates.exact_span: TSS = Total suspended solids concentration found in receiving stream (or in effluent for intermittent stream)
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether TSS is taken from the receiving stream or effluent (intermittent stream case) changes Kp, dissolved limits (A), and whether TSS monitoring was conditionally required to establish applicability.
This conversion from dissolved criteria Cr to total-metal criteria Ct determines the enforceable numeric total-metal limit applied to reported total-metal measurements.

candidates.exact_span: Stream Linear Partition Coefficient                                                             Lake Linear Partition Coefficient
candidates.computation_change_reason: Choosing stream versus lake partition coefficients changes dissolved-metal limits (A) and depends on correctly classifying the receiving water, which affects conditional monitoring/limit applicability (B).

The stream dissolved value of 0 for Chromium III is ambiguous (no criterion, not applicable, or tabular placeholder); different readings change whether a numeric dissolved limit exists for comparison.

candidates.exact_span: If Stream pH < 6.5, enter 750 in cell O113
candidates.computation_change_reason: The pH-triggered override replaces the hardness-derived acute aluminum limit with a fixed value of 750; whether pH<6.5 applies changes the enforceable limit (A) and whether pH-conditioned criteria/monitoring obligations are triggered (B).

candidates.exact_span: If Stream pH < 6.5, enter 87 in cell P113
candidates.computation_change_reason: The pH-triggered override replaces the hardness-derived chronic aluminum limit with a fixed value of 87; whether pH<6.5 applies changes the enforceable limit (A) and conditional applicability of related monitoring (B).

The cadmium acute hardness correction factor changes the computed acute dissolved limit; different hardness inputs or factor interpretation alter exceedance results (A) and whether hardness evidence was required to establish limit applicability (B).
